info.name: ContextForge API v1
info.description: End-to-end run of the ContextForge API: auth, CRUD, RBAC (401/403), admin review, config generation, soft delete. Run the folders in order. Login and register share a 10 req/min budget, so wait one minute between full runs.

item.name: Owner can see own unverified server
Dev B edits Dev A server -> 403 (IDOR)

exec: pm.test('includes the new server as pending', () => { const s = pm.response.json().data.find(x => x.server_id === pm.collectionVariables.get('serverId')); pm.expect(s.latest_review.status).to.eql('pending'); });

pm.test('env value is a placeholder', () => { const j = pm.response.json().data.generated_json.config; pm.expect(j.mcpServers['demo-server-' + pm.collectionVariables.get('runId')].env.DEMO_API_KEY).to.eql('YOUR_DEMO_API_KEY_HERE'); });

item.name: Taken-down server is gone from public -> 404

exec: pm.test('snapshot still lists the server', () => pm.expect(Object.keys(pm.response.json().data.generated_json.config.mcpServers)).to.include('demo-server-' + pm.collectionVariables.get('runId')));
